scope: Remove executeAction through public API, React, client, host, core, and wire. Use canonical NEAR signAndSendTransaction with actions arrays.
failureContract: The removed executeAction converted exceptions into success:false. The canonical signAndSendTransaction rejects signing and broadcast failures. Callers and documentation adopt the canonical contract.

protocol.releaseRule: Publish and roll back a matching client/host pair. Mixed protocol versions reject. No release or deployment performed.

productionLines.exclusions: Type fixtures, tests, documentation, generated artifacts, lockfiles

cases: [wallet-intended] 1/3 e2e/intended-behaviours/passkey.ed25519-yao-local.contract.test.ts:11 public Ed25519 Yao registration signs immediately and after refresh
[wallet-intended] 2/3 e2e/intended-behaviours/passkey.registration.contract.test.ts:17 wallet protocol rejection shows an upgrade message and reload restores registration and signing
[wallet-intended] 3/3 e2e/intended-behaviours/passkey.registration.contract.test.ts:459 passkey registration establishes an immediately usable owner session without waiting for presignatures
verification.productionCommand: SEAMS_INTENDED_PRODUCTION=1 SEAMS_INTENDED_SKIP_BUILD=1 node tests/scripts/run-wallet-intended-isolated.mjs --require-google-token -- e2e/intended-behaviours/passkey.registration.contract.test.ts e2e/intended-behaviours/passkey.ed25519-yao-local.contract.test.ts --grep 'wallet protocol rejection|public Ed25519 Yao registration signs immediately|passkey registration establishes an immediately usable owner session'
verification.browserCommand: SEAMS_TEST_FRONTEND_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4289 pnpm -C tests exec playwright test -c playwright.wallet-browser.config.ts wallet-iframe/handshake.test.ts wallet-iframe/router.behavior.test.ts wallet-iframe/router.cancellationProgress.test.ts wallet-iframe/router.connectionClosed.test.ts wallet-iframe/router.sessionExpiryLifecycle.test.ts wallet-iframe/preferences.queue.test.ts wallet-ui/transaction-review.browser.test.ts --project=chromium --output=../.artifacts/r170-near-consolidation

limitations: Browser cases verify canonical transport, errors, cancellation and version rejection against stub hosts.
Production cases use the current real iframe host for registration/signing; the protocol-rejection case exercises the registration HTTP contract, not an old deployed iframe host.
No live-chain NEAR broadcast acceptance claim.
NEAR signing/message/delegate names, funding-tool exports, remaining worker/performance/browser/consumer-release gates remain open.
